name: lists-commitment-detail
title: Commitment list
description: One commitment list, flat in code order, each commitment opening to its requirements; a Source Document filter narrows the list, and a requirement opens its source text in a side panel. Word and CSV export, no API.

sections.label: Filter row

guide.intent: Search plus a Source picker ("All source documents"). No view tabs: commitment lists are flat, per Andy.
decisions: Source filters cards by data-source (ListMemberRow.source). The fixture has one source document (the ITP); the picker stays so the shape holds when a project has several.
acceptance: Picking the ITP keeps every card; clearing restores the same set.

guide.intent: PDF, then prod's CSV and Excel downloads in the rail, then Word (a later slice, BCN-1764).
decisions: PDF downloads the commitment list document (see the list-export-commitment-pdf spec): `GET commitment-lists/{commitmentListID}/generate-pdf`. Every list has one, an empty list included (Andy, 2026-10-19).

LATER SLICE, not this epic: Word is BCN-1764, under epic BCN-1922. The design is settled and the prototype's download works: the SAME document as the PDF, as a .docx from `GET commitment-lists/{commitmentListID}/generate-docx`, beside generate-pdf. Same title block, summary, detail and order; Word's own pagination, with the summary table's header row repeating on each page. The prototype builds a .doc from the print route (list-word.ts), so its content cannot drift from the PDF (Andy, 2026-10-20: "show as active").
No JSON/API section; that is obligation-only.
